g1.label: 1. What did Edison invent in 1879?
g1.why: The text says Edison invented the electric light bulb in 1879.

g2.label: 2. How many materials did Edison test?
g2.why: The text says Edison tested more than 1,000 materials for the filament.

g3.label: 3. When did Bell make the first call?
g3.why: The text says Bell made the first telephone call in 1876.

g4.label: 4. How long did the first flight last?
g4.why: The text says the Wright Brothers’ first flight lasted twelve seconds.

g5.correct: so that everyone could afford it
accept: so that everyone could afford it
g5.label: 5. Why did Salk refuse to patent the vaccine?
g5.why: The text says Salk refused to patent the vaccine so that everyone could afford it.

g6.label: 6. How did people communicate before the telephone?
g6.why: The text says people communicated quickly by sending telegrams before the telephone.

g1.label: 1. Edison worked ___
g1.why: ‘Hard’ is both the adjective and adverb form here (‘hardly’ means ‘barely’, a different meaning).

g2.label: 2. An ___ important invention
g2.why: An adverb is needed to modify the adjective ‘important’, so ‘incredibly’ is used, not ‘incredible’.

g3.label: 3. A ___ moment
g3.why: An adjective is needed after ‘was’ to describe the moment, so ‘remarkable’ is used, not the adverb ‘remarkably’.

g4.label: 4. Flew their plane ___
g4.why: An adverb is needed to modify the verb ‘flew’, so ‘successfully’ is used, not the adjective ‘successful’.

g5.label: 5. Salk ___ refused
g5.why: An adverb is needed to modify the verb ‘refused’, so ‘generously’ is used, not the adjective ‘generous’.

g6.label: 6. Changed our lives ___
g6.why: An adverb is needed to modify the verb ‘changed’, so ‘dramatically’ is used, not the adjective ‘dramatic’.

g7.label: 7. Polio was a ___ disease
g7.why: An adjective is needed after ‘was’ to describe the disease, so ‘terrible’ is used, not the adverb ‘terribly’.

g8.label: 8. The first flight was ___ short
g8.why: An adverb is needed to modify the adjective ‘short’, so ‘extremely’ is used, not the adjective ‘extreme’.

g1.label: 1. The story is really ___
g1.why: The -ing participle describes the thing causing the feeling: the story is fascinating.

g2.label: 2. People were ___
g2.why: The -ed participle describes how people felt: people were amazed.

g3.label: 3. The achievement was truly ___
g3.why: The -ing participle describes the thing causing the feeling: the achievement was astonishing.

g4.label: 4. Students are often ___
g4.why: The -ed participle describes how people feel: students are interested.

g5.label: 5. Salk's decision was ___
g5.why: The -ing participle describes the thing causing the feeling: the decision was surprising.

g6.label: 6. Children with polio were often ___
g6.why: The -ed participle describes how people felt: children were frightened.

g7.label: 7. The growth of the internet has been ___
g7.why: The -ing participle describes the thing causing the feeling: the growth has been shocking.

g8.label: 8. Many young people feel ___
g8.why: The -ed participle describes how people feel: young people feel excited.
